releaseNotes:
• Fixed Crash on Camera Scan: Requests CAMERA permission before launching Food Plate or Nutrition Label scanner instead of throwing SecurityException.
• Safe Settings & Receiver Handling: Added try/catch + OEM fallback for Usage Access Settings and ContextCompat.RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED guard for screen receiver.
• Clearer Android 13+ Restricted Settings Guide: Step-by-step instructions when Usage Access toggle is greyed out (App Info -> ⋮ -> Allow restricted settings).
